item.title: Windows 8.1 ISO download for 64 and 32 bit | Microsoft Community Hub
item.description: Since Microsoft has shifted focus to Windows 10 and Windows 11, official direct downloads for Windows 8 ISOs are no longer prominently available from Microsoft. item.title: Close your Outlook.com account | Microsoft Support
item.description: When you close your Microsoft account, your email and contacts are deleted from our servers and can't be recovered. If you use your Microsoft account with Xbox, Skype, OneDrive, or other Microsoft services, you'll no longer be able to access those services. You will also lose access to any saved BitLocker recovery keys.
